message.dglab.safety_notice: DG-LAB safety: set the strength limits in the app first, keep electrodes away from your chest, head, and neck, and stop if you feel unwell. Turning DG-LAB Output off sets both channels to zero.
options.dglab.title: dglab Settings
options.dglab.reset_page.tooltip: Reset every setting on this page to its default.
options.dglab.reset_page.tooltip.unsaved: Set everything on this page to its default. Done saves it.
options.dglab.pair.tooltip: Show the QR code the DG-LAB app scans to connect.
options.dglab.server_enabled.tooltip: Whether the server the DG-LAB app connects to is running. It starts with the game. Turning it off sets both channels to zero and disconnects the app.
options.dglab.connection.tooltip: Change the port and the address in the QR code.
options.dglab.enabled.tooltip: The master switch. While it is off, both channels stay at zero and game events are ignored.
options.dglab.output_multiplier.tooltip: Scales the strength that damage, death, and the low health floor produce on both channels. At 0%, game events produce no output. The strength never exceeds the limits set in the app.
options.dglab.channel_a.tooltip: Whether channel A reacts to game events. Turning it off sets the channel to zero.
options.dglab.channel_b.tooltip: Whether channel B reacts to game events. Turning it off sets the channel to zero.
options.dglab.damage_response.tooltip: Whether taking damage raises the strength.
options.dglab.health_floor.tooltip: Whether the strength stops decaying at a floor that grows as you lose health.
options.dglab.strength.tooltip: Change how much each channel reacts and how fast it decays.
options.dglab.waveforms.tooltip: Choose or edit the waveform each channel plays after damage and while it recovers.
options.dglab.hud.tooltip: Whether both channels' strength is shown on screen.
options.dglab.hud_limit.tooltip: Whether the HUD also shows the limits set in the DG-LAB app.
options.dglab.hud_x.tooltip: Horizontal position of the HUD, from the left edge (0%) to the right edge (100%).
options.dglab.hud_y.tooltip: Vertical position of the HUD, from the top edge (0%) to the bottom edge (100%).
options.dglab.two_player.tooltip: While you host a world opened to LAN and the chosen player is in it, your health drives channel A and that player's health drives channel B.
options.dglab.two_player.title: Two-Player Settings
options.dglab.two_player.description: Two-player mode only works while you host a world opened to LAN.
options.dglab.two_player.quit_strength.t: Strength added to channel B when the second player leaves the world alive.
options.dglab.strength.title: Strength Settings
options.dglab.strength.strength_per_dama: Strength added for each point of damage (half a heart). The result is rounded down, but any damage adds at least 1. At 0, damage is ignored.
options.dglab.strength.hold_ticks.toolti: How long the strength stays up after damage before it starts to decay. More damage restarts this time instead of adding to it.
options.dglab.strength.decay_step.toolti: Strength removed by each decay step. At 0, the strength never decays.
options.dglab.strength.death_strength.to: Strength added when you die, on top of the strength the fatal damage added.
How long the strength stays up after death before it starts to decay.
options.dglab.strength.floor_strength.to: The strength does not decay below this value times the share of health you have lost. For example, at half health the floor is half of this value.
options.dglab.pair.title: Pair Device
options.dglab.pair.state.stopped: The connection server is switched off. Turn it on in the settings to pair a device.
options.dglab.pair.state.listening: In the DG-LAB app, open SOCKET control and scan this code. The phone must be on the same network as this computer.
options.dglab.pair.state.failed: Port %s could not be opened. Choose another port in the connection settings.
options.dglab.connection.title: Connection Settings
options.dglab.connection.listen_port.too: The port the connection server listens on. Changing it restarts the server.
options.dglab.connection.qr_address.tool: The address of this computer that the QR code sends the phone to. Change it if the automatic choice is on the wrong network.
options.dglab.connection.qr_port.tooltip: The port the QR code sends the phone to. Leave it empty unless the phone reaches the server through a different port.
options.dglab.waveforms.title: Waveforms
options.dglab.waveform.preset.tooltip: Choose a built-in waveform, or Custom for the waveform made in the editor.
options.dglab.waveform.test.tooltip: Play this waveform once on its channel. It needs a connected app, and you only feel it while the channel's strength is above zero.
options.dglab.waveform.edit.tooltip: Open the editor for this slot's custom waveform. Saving it there makes the slot use it.
options.dglab.waveform.editor.title: Edit Waveform - %s
The device's frequency value. A higher value means slower pulses.
options.dglab.waveform.editor.mode.toolt: Manual: you set this sample. Auto: it is interpolated between the nearest manual samples.
options.dglab.waveform.editor.copy.toolt: Copy the waveform as hexadecimal code to the clipboard.
options.dglab.waveform.editor.paste.tool: Replace the waveform with hexadecimal code from the clipboard.
options.dglab.waveform.editor.paste_fail: The clipboard does not hold valid waveform code.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dglab: Reflects in-game experiences to DG-LAB devices.
